moderationItems.title: Urgent Guest Soloist Position - Unclear Fee Structure
moderationItems.author: Soren Vang (Neumeier Inst.)
moderationItems.contentPreview: "Posting requires dancers to pay a 150 EUR "audition registration fee" via non-traceable wire before receiving contract details for Swan Lake tour."
moderationItems.flagReason: This posting broke a rule — dancers shouldn't be asked to pay before receiving contract details

moderationItems.title: Unauthorized Rehearsal Video Distribution
moderationItems.author: Anonymized Account #4412
moderationItems.contentPreview: "Thread contains Google Drive link hosting unreleased choreography footage from La Scala 2027 season production rehearsal."
moderationItems.flagReason: Someone used another person's content without permission.

moderationItems.title: Unauthorized Use of Dancer Images in Promotional Material
moderationItems.author: Miguel Fernandez (DanceWatch)
moderationItems.contentPreview: "Promotional flyers showcase dancer photos without consent for an upcoming contemporary dance festival."
moderationItems.flagReason: Violation of Privacy and Image Rights Policy 5.4 (Use of personal images requires explicit permission).

moderationItems.title: False Salary Representation in Job Posting
moderationItems.author: Jasmine Lee (BalletNet)
moderationItems.contentPreview: "Job ad promises a salary of $10,000/month, but official contract offers only $6,000/month."
moderationItems.flagReason: Violation of Platform Fair Job Posting Rule 2.3 (Accurate compensation details mandatory).

moderationItems.title: Spam Advertising for Unverified Masterclass
moderationItems.author: Alex Rivera
moderationItems.contentPreview: "Repeated posts redirecting users to external payment gateway for unverified virtual workshop."
moderationItems.flagReason: Automated promotional spam detected across multiple threads.
